38:        # short-circuit for the trivial case
39:        return None
40:    # Determine the stop indices of the preferred chunks, but omit the last stop
41:    # (equal to the dim size).  In particular, assume that when a sequence
42:    # expresses the preferred chunks, the sequence sums to the size.
43:    preferred_stops = (
44:        range(preferred_chunk_sizes, size, preferred_chunk_sizes)
45:        if isinstance(preferred_chunk_sizes, int)
46:        else set(itertools.accumulate(preferred_chunk_sizes[:-1]))
47:    )

50:    # of a preferred chunk. Again, omit the last stop, assuming that it equals
51:    # the dim size.

53:    # This copy is required for parallel iteration

55:
56:    disagrees = itertools.compress(
57:        actual_stops_2, (a not in preferred_stops for a in actual_stops)
58:    )
59:    try:
60:        return next(disagrees)
61:    except StopIteration:
